column1: # INV-T-6256. The callingSystem rows come from the ruling of INV-Q-6252 on INV-REQ-587 (which names `filing-workflow` and no property of its own).
# INV-T-4910. Identifiers in backticks in the published behavior and intent of INV-REQ-584, 912, 955, 1269, 2758, 2762 (read from Keel),
# plus the four names of rulings INV-Q-5143/5145/5147 that no requirement writes in backticks. Columns: identifier, kind, file, requirement key.
# Spelling rule (API-09): the identifier column holds the contract spelling, an enum member in UPPER_SNAKE_CASE (hyphen to underscore) and a
# property in camelCase, so `filing-workflow` is the row FILING_WORKFLOW and `SUBMIT_INVOICE_DATA` is the row submitInvoiceData.
# Not rows, because they are not access-contract elements: confirmFiling (submission/openapi.yaml); private_key_jwt and client_secret_basic
# (the VP-77 authentication settings, INV-REQ-2760, not access operations or schemas); security.officer, platform.engineer and
# deployment.operator (roles); access-svc and notification-svc (services); MessageDelivery (a port of notification-svc, INV-REQ-817);
# MessageRequested (a message name under components.messages of access/asyncapi.yaml, not a properties key, an operationId or an enum member).
# INV-T-7988. INV-REQ-2756: the backticked names (tenant.admin, a role; access-svc, a service) are not contract elements, so they are not rows.

# INV-T-8225. INV-AC-8224: the backticked names tenant.admin and commercial.admin are roles, grantRole is a row that exists, and provisionTenant is an operation of the control-plane contract that exists, so they add no row.

# INV-T-8672. INV-AC-8671: the backticked names security.officer, tenant.admin, deployment.operator and tax.approver are roles, and mapIdpGroup, unlockBreakGlass, resealBreakGlass and AuthorityChanged exist already, so they add no row.

# INV-T-8807. INV-AC-8806: the backticked names ingest, filing-workflow, ap-callback, reporting, monitoring and certification are rows as enum members already; security.officer and tenant.admin are roles; evidence-svc and access-svc are services; confirmFiling is an operation of submission/openapi.yaml; private_key_jwt and client_secret_basic are the VP-77 settings, whose contract members are the CredentialInfo.method rows, so they add no further row.

# INV-T-8849. INV-AC-8847: the backticked names authenticatePrincipal, getVerificationKeys and revokePrincipal are operations that exist already or are rows of INV-T-8807; the eleven claim names are asserted by the description check of the merge request, not by this table; the six machine scopes are rows as enum members already, so they add no further row.
